note: model_class: online inputs are generated by get_inputs() inside the task file from the global RNG (the evaluator calls it after set_seed). This file records the fixed shape family of get_inputs as the machine-readable form of the task contract; tolerance and global-domain shape constraints are in task.yaml. Hidden/perf cases are {name + semantic fields} dicts: name is a metadata key that the consumer strips, then calls reference.py::make_inputs(**fields) with the remaining semantic fields for deterministic generation.

shape_family.out_layout: single tensor (N, K, H_out, W_out), contiguous NCHW layout; inherently single-output, no multi-output packing
